segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Yes, what can I do for you?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: My friend is in homestay ... and she really enjoys it .. . so I'd like to join a family as well.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Okay, so let me get some details. What's your name?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: My name is Keiko Yuichini.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Could you spell your family name for me?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: It's ... Yuchini, that's Y-U-I-C-H-I-N-I.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: And your first name?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: It's Keiko. K-E-I-K-0.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: That's Keiko Yuichini . . . okay .. . and you're female. And your nationality?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I'm Japanese.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Right and could I see your passport, please?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Here it is ...

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Okay .. . your passport number is JO 6337 ... And you're how old?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I'm twenty-eight years old.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Now, you live at one of the colleges ... which one? . STUDENT: Willow College, umm ... Room 21 C

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Right, 21C Willow College, and how long are you planning on staying with homestay?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: About four months ... longer if I like it . . .

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: And what course are you enrolled in?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Well, I've enrolled for twenty weeks in the ... urn ... Advanced English Studies because I need help with my writing ... and I'm nearly at the end of my first five-week course.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Okay . .. Do you have any preference for a family with children or without children?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I prefer . .. I mean I like young children, but I'd like to be with older people .. . you know ... adults .. . someone around my age.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Okay, and what about pets?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I am a veterinarian so that's fine ... the more the better.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: All right, now what about you? Are you a vegetarian or do you have any special food requirements?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: No, I am not a vegetarian ... but I don't eat a lot of meat ... I really like seafood.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: And what are your hobbies?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I like reading and going to the movies.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Do you play any sports?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, I joined the handball team, but I didn't like that . . . so I stopped playing. Now I play tennis on the weekend with my friends. . . QB

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: All right, let's see, name, age, now the location. Are you familiar with the public transport system?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: No ... I'm not really because I have been living on campus . .. I've been to the city a few times on the bus, but they are always late.

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: What about the trains?

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: I like catching the train .. . they are much faster . . .

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: Now, let me go check on the computer and see who I've got ... Listen, leave it with me .. . I'll check my records and I'll give you details this afternoon.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Thank you for helping me .. .

segments.speaker: OFFICER
segments.en: It's a pleasure. Bye.

segments.speaker: STUDENT
segments.en: Bye.
